lines.cap: This family didn't kiss the Pope's ring. They made the ring.
lines.say: This family didn't kiss the Pope's ring. They made the ring.

lines.cap: Florence, 1397. The Medici open a bank. Soon they're handling the Pope's money.
lines.say: Florence, 1397. The Medici open a bank. Soon they're handling the Pope's money.

lines.cap: Cosimo de Medici never wore a crown. He just owned everyone who did. Florence did what his money said.
lines.say: Cosimo de Medici never wore a crown. He just owned everyone who did. Florence did what his money said.

lines.cap: They paid for the Renaissance. Brunelleschi's dome. Donatello. A teenage Michelangelo lived in their house.
lines.say: They paid for the Renaissance. Brunelleschi's dome. Donatello. A teenage Michelangelo lived in their house.

lines.cap: In 1478, killers attacked the two Medici brothers during Mass, in front of the altar. Giuliano was stabbed nineteen times. Lorenzo escaped.
lines.say: In 1478, killers attacked the two Medici brothers during Mass, in front of the altar. Giuliano was stabbed nineteen times. Lorenzo escaped.

lines.cap: Then they stopped paying popes, and started making them. In 1513, Giovanni de Medici became Pope Leo the Tenth.
lines.say: Then they stopped paying popes, and started making them. In 1513, Giovanni de Medici became Pope Leo the Tenth.

lines.cap: And what did he do with the church's money? He got a white elephant. Named Hanno. It had its own keeper and its own portrait.
lines.say: And what did he do with the church's money? He got a white elephant. Named Hanno. It had its own keeper and its own portrait.

lines.cap: Ten years later, his cousin became Pope too.
lines.say: Ten years later, his cousin became Pope too.
